blocks.stage: REPASO EXPRESS · vocabulario de hoy
blocks.title: <ico-recycle></ico-recycle> REPASO EXPRESS
blocks.intro: Primero, fija el vocabulario clave de hoy. Une cada palabra con su significado.

pairs.l: Hi, I don't think we've met. I'm…
pairs.r: Hola, creo que no nos conocemos. Soy…

blocks.title: <ico-briefcase></ico-briefcase> SAY WHO YOU ARE
blocks.intro: En una reunión o evento, primero saludas, luego dices tu puesto y qué haces (present simple: I + verb). Sin traductor — practica en voz alta.

parts.html: Greetings — para conocer gente en el trabajo:

items.en: Hi, I don't think we've met. I'm…
items.sp: Hola, creo que no nos conocemos. Soy…

items.en: Nice to meet you. / Good to see you again.
items.sp: Encantado/a. / Qué bueno verte otra vez.

items.en: How's it going? / How have you been?
What do you do? / What's your role?
items.sp: ¿A qué te dedicas? / ¿Cuál es tu puesto?

parts.body: Openers más formales: "It's a pleasure to finally meet you in person." · "I've heard so much about you." · "I hope you're doing well."

parts.html: Job titles & responsibilities — di tu puesto, luego qué haces:

items.en: Manager — I manage a team and plan our projects.
Assistant — I help my manager and organize meetings.
Sales Rep — I talk to clients and sell our products.
Accountant — I take care of the money and the budgets.
Developer — I build and fix our apps and websites.
Customer Support — I answer questions and solve problems.

parts.body: Puestos senior + verbos: "I oversee strategic planning," "I manage cross-functional teams," "I'm responsible for driving our digital strategy," "My role involves liaising between departments."

blocks.stage: ① VOCAB & GRAMMAR · quién eres + preposiciones

blocks.title: <ico-book></ico-book> PREPOSITIONS · TIME / PLACE / MOVEMENT
blocks.intro: Truco: van de lo pequeño/exacto a lo grande/general.

cells.body:
Time: at 3 p.m. · at noon · at night
Place: at the office · at the door

Time: on Monday · on May 5 · on the weekend
Place: on the desk · on the second floor

Time: in July · in 2026 · in the morning
Place: in a meeting room · in New York

to the office (hacia)
into the room (hacia adentro)
onto the table (sobre)

parts.body: US American English: decimos on the weekend (no "at the weekend"), in the morning / afternoon / evening pero at night, y at work / at home (no "in work").

blocks.title: <ico-star></ico-star> AT THE CONFERENCE
blocks.intro: Ana y Toni se conocen en una conferencia. Primero practicas las preposiciones y el small talk, y luego los escuchas en 2 audios: un diálogo y un voicemail.
blocks.stage: ② THE STORY · Ana conoce a Toni

blocks.title: CHOOSE THE PREPOSITION
blocks.intro: Piensa: ¿un punto (at), un día/superficie (on), un período/espacio (in), o movimiento (to/into)?

items.q: The presentation is ___ the second floor.
We have a team call ___ Tuesday morning.
The train arrives ___ five minutes.
She walked ___ the meeting room and sat down.

speaking.prompt: Preséntate: tu puesto y qué haces. Usa 3 preposiciones (at / on / in / to).
speaking.starter: I'm a project manager at a software company. I work with clients in Europe, and I have meetings on Mondays…

blocks.stage: ③ PRACTICE · elige la respuesta

blocks.title: SMALL TALK · CHOOSE THE BEST REPLY
blocks.intro: Elige la mejor respuesta para cada pregunta de small talk.

options: It was great, thanks — I went hiking. How about you?
I'm a project manager at a software company.

items.q: "Is this your first time at this event?"
options: Yes, it is — it's bigger than I expected!

blocks.title: ORDENA LA FRASE
blocks.intro: Toca las palabras para formar la frase correcta.

blocks.title: AUDIO 1 · MEETING AT THE CONFERENCE
blocks.desc: Ana y Toni se conocen. Fíjate en los puestos, el tiempo y el lugar.

options: A project coordinator at Lumen Design
At the coffee break, by the main entrance
On the fifth floor, by the meeting rooms
At the main entrance, after the talks

speaking.prompt: Ask a coworker 2 small-talk questions and answer them yourself.

transcript.html: Hi, I don't think we've met. I'm Ana. I work at Lumen Design.
Nice to meet you, Ana. I'm Toni, a marketing specialist at BrightBox.
Marketing! What do you do there exactly?
I manage our social media, and I help with campaigns. And you?
I'm a project coordinator. I work with clients from Europe and the US.
Nice. Is this your first time at this conference?
Yes, it is. I arrived on Monday, and the talks start tomorrow at nine.
Same here. There's a coffee break at eleven. Do you want to continue then?
Sounds good. See you at the break, by the main entrance.

blocks.stage: ④ LISTENING · escucha a Ana y Toni

blocks.title: AUDIO 2 · SARA'S VOICEMAIL
blocks.desc: Sara deja un mensaje antes de una reunión. Fíjate en su puesto y en el cuándo y dónde.

options: On Thursday, at ten in the morning
On Monday, at nine in the morning
On Friday, at ten in the morning
At the main office, by the front entrance
At the downtown office, on the first floor
At the downtown office, on the fifth floor

transcript.html: Hi, this is Sara Miller. I'm the account manager for your project at Northwind. I manage our client relationships, and I work closely with the design team. I'm calling about our meeting on Thursday at ten, in the morning. It will be at our downtown office, on the fifth floor. My colleague David, our project lead, will join us. If you have any questions before then, you can reach me at the office. Thanks, and see you on Thursday!

blocks.title: <ico-pen></ico-pen> YOUR PROFESSIONAL INTRO
blocks.intro: Escribe un párrafo (5–6 oraciones unidas, no una lista) presentándote en el trabajo. Usa:
checklist: Tu puesto y qué haces (I'm a…, I manage…, I work with…)
Al menos 5 preposiciones de tiempo, lugar y movimiento
Une las ideas con and, but, also, so — un párrafo
blocks.placeholder: Hi, I'm... I work at... I'm a..., and I...
blocks.example: Hi, I'm ___. I work ___ ___ [company], and I'm a ___ [job]. I ___ [responsibility], and I work ___ clients ___ [place]. We usually have meetings ___ Mondays, ___ the morning. Today I'm here ___ a conference, so I'm meeting a lot of new people.
blocks.exampleLabel: COMPLETA — at / on / in / to + tu info
blocks.hw: Escribe tu párrafo y después grábate presentándote sin leer, como en un evento real. Envíame ambos por WhatsApp.
blocks.stage: ⑤ WRITING · en clase o tarea (HW)

rubric.d: Escribiste lo que pide la consigna, completo y en el formato pedido.
Usaste las preposiciones at / on / in / to y el lenguaje para presentarte al menos 3 veces, y bien.
Se entiende sin releer: ideas unidas, sin traducir literal del español.
